scene: A narrow rain-soaked alley at night in a weathered harbour town, wet cobblestones reflecting neon signs

subjects.description: A young woman with long red braided hair, pale freckled skin and a dark green hooded wool cloak, holding a small brass compass in her right hand
subjects.position: right third of the frame, waist-up
subjects.action: turning her head toward the viewer as if interrupted
subjects.pose: body angled three-quarters away, head turned back over the left shoulder

style: painterly cinematic concept art, visible brush texture, storyboard key frame
lighting: cool cyan neon rim light from the left, warm sodium street lamp glow from behind, soft fill from wet ground reflections
mood: tense, secretive, quiet before a chase
background: stacked crates, a steaming vent, a faded shop sign reading "MARLOW & SONS", distant harbour cranes in mist
composition: rule of thirds, strong diagonal of the alley walls leading to the woman, foreground rain streaks

camera.angle: low angle, slightly below eye level
